context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety, artifact-first, missing-data, and P14 boundary rules.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; rendered reports are views only.
Missing values must be encoded explicitly as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON rather than invented or silently omitted.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not automatic and must not be run or treated as real Valkey evidence.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm automatic phase boundary and P14 opt-in rule.
key_findings: Automatic work stops before P14.
P14 requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN and is dry-run/resource-check only.
Reports must read artifacts and cannot become the source of truth.
review_agent must independently review the diff against stage_design.md.
The review verdict must be APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED/BLOCKED.
The JSON response must follow schemas/loop_engineering/subagent_response.schema.json.
L02 must build a provenance DAG with source artifact, sha256, producer, schema, phase, and run_id coverage.
P09 report, P11 stability report, and P12/P13 scale reports must trace back to source artifacts.
The DAG must be written to artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json.

context_files_read.purpose: Detailed L02 design and prior finding criteria.
key_findings: The builder must compute SHA256 from disk and distinguish source-of-truth artifacts from rendered views.
Blocking findings include missing required sources, hash mismatches, graph cycles, missing endpoints, report views used as sources, P14 real coverage, and required coverage gaps.
Nonblocking findings may record missing optional metadata only when the graph explicitly marks the missing field as MISSING.
P13 timing nodes must trace to setup timeline, runtime timing breakdown, real evidence, and cleanup artifacts where present.
The planned gate is static-only: build the provenance graph, validate its schema, and run provenance CI tests.
The plan requires P09/P11/P12/P13 coverage and report-view/source-of-truth separation.
No P14, real Valkey, or fault wrapper command may run for L02.
Prior finding REVIEW-L02-001 required schema-invalid required source nodes to produce blocking invalid_source_schema findings.
Prior finding REVIEW-L02-002 required missing metadata to be explicit through metadata_status and/or missing_metadata findings.

Prior finding REVIEW-L02-003 required P13 setup timeline provenance to point from setup_timeline_scale_* into p13_timing_breakdown_scale_* rather than accepting the legacy reverse source_artifact edge.
Required provenance source relations include setup_timeline_source.
Legacy P13 setup timeline source_artifacts entries pointing back to p13_timing_breakdown_scale_* are skipped with nonblocking legacy_declared_source_skipped findings.

P13 timing now adds setup_timeline_scale_* -> p13_timing_breakdown_scale_* edges using relation setup_timeline_source and separately links runtime timing, real evidence, cleanup, and setup/cleanup logs into the timing artifact.

evaluate_node_metadata now attaches metadata_status to every node, emits blocking invalid_source_schema findings for invalid required source schemas, and emits nonblocking missing_metadata findings for absent metadata.
P14 boundary logic requires P14 to remain non-automatic and reports real_valkey_coverage=false.
Current-repo tests assert graph PASS, zero blocking findings, P09/P11/P12/P13 PASS coverage, P14 real_valkey_coverage=false, and report views not used as upstream sources.
Fixture tests prove missing sources, hash drift, report-view misuse, invalid required source schema, missing metadata visibility, graph cycles, and duplicate edge prevention.

P13 tests assert setup_timeline_scale_50.json -> p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json with relation setup_timeline_source and assert the reverse p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json -> setup_timeline_scale_50.json source_artifact edge is absent.
The CI guard runs the provenance builder, validates the graph schema, checks graph status PASS, and enforces static workflow commands.
The workflow forbidden-token check covers P14, VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, and fault_failover_gate.py.
The CI guard keeps L02 static-only.
Nodes require metadata_status with artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, producer, status, and schema entries.
metadata_status values are constrained to PRESENT, VALID, INVALID, MISSING, or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Summary includes missing_metadata_count and invalid_source_schema_count.
The workflow runs the provenance graph builder, provenance schema validation, and provenance pytest suite.
The workflow does not run P14 or any real Valkey/fault wrapper command.
The workflow addition preserves the existing fast-gate structure.

The committed graph reports status PASS, 95 nodes, 70 edges, zero blocking findings, zero missing sources, zero hash mismatches, 11 nonblocking missing_metadata findings, and zero invalid_source_schema findings.
P09/P11/P12/P13 phase_coverage entries are PASS with no finding_ids.
P14 boundary is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, automatic=false, and real_valkey_coverage=false.
P13 setup_timeline_scale_50 and setup_timeline_scale_100 are upstream setup_timeline_source nodes for p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50 and p13_timing_breakdown_scale_100.
The legacy p13_timing_breakdown_scale_* -> setup_timeline_scale_* source_artifact declarations are represented only as nonblocking legacy_declared_source_skipped findings, not accepted edges.
The review artifact must use schema_version v1, agent_role review_agent, required context/findings/plan arrays, and verdict APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
additionalProperties are not allowed at the top level.

acceptance_criteria: Prior finding REVIEW-L02-001 is fixed: invalid required source schemas produce blocking invalid_source_schema findings and have fixture coverage.
Prior finding REVIEW-L02-002 is fixed: node metadata_status records MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON/VALID/PRESENT states and missing metadata is emitted as nonblocking missing_metadata findings.

Prior finding REVIEW-L02-003 is fixed: P13 setup timeline artifacts are modeled as setup_timeline_source inputs to p13_timing_breakdown_scale_* and the legacy reverse source_artifact declarations are skipped.
The current committed provenance graph remains PASS with zero blocking findings.
P14 remains SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with real_valkey_coverage=false and no L02 command ran P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.
